Father mentioned at A-level decision but words lost; 'neither' is the safe middle, low confidence apt.

'apply what I've learnt' directly supports applying theory on placement.

'treated equal' = disagree that female students get more help.
Notes packed hours but no clear dis/satisfaction; neutral apt, low confidence.
'the salary's a big one' = very important.
'training aspect as well is quite important' = important.
